title: Design for Services
description:
If you are in a business, it's probably because you have a product to sell, an experience to deliver or a service to offer. Products are designed and so are many experiences; because they are tangible to the audience or the customer.

But what about services?

Be it digital enterprise or a traditional one, a product company or a knowledge company, B2B or B2C business... there is always a 'service' quotient to every business.

What is Service Design?
Why should services be designed?
Who does it benefit? How is it done?
